notes.title: Launching on Kickstarter
notes.content:
Our Kickstarter campaign has begun 🎉

**Early Bird Bundle and More** 
Act fast to get the Early Bird Bundle that’s only available for the first 48 hours!

In the Early Bird Bundle you’ll get:
- Digital copy of Retro Drive: Revamped for PC
- Digital copy of Retro Drive: Revamped soundtrack
- “Backer” car and racing visual effects
- Wallpaper set for PC and mobile
- “Backer” Discord role
- Name in credits as “Backer”

**Limited amount of rewards to join us for our next game**
🏎️  Design a car
🏁  Create a race track level
🌟  Become an in-game character 

**New Demo**
Check out our new demo that’s just gone live to celebrate the launch of our Kickstarter

🎮  Controller and Steam Deck 
🛡️  Shield buff for your car
🚧  Oil spills and laser gates balanced
🌆  3 tracks
🚗  2 cars


**Support us on Kickstarter:** https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/retromiami/retro-drive-revamped-80s-synthwave-racer

notes.title: LAST CHANCE TO WIN $25 - NEXT FEST SUPER RACE
notes.content:
[h1]EXPERIENCE THE FUTURE: [i]NEXT FEST[/i] EXCLUSIVE![/h1]

Our exclusive demo is live only during this event, offering you a unique opportunity to immerse yourself in the thrilling world of [i]Retro Drive Revamped[/i]. Don't miss out – dive into the demo now, and while you're at it, be sure to [b]wishlist[/b] the game and [b]join our Discord[/b] for all the latest updates!

[h2]𝓗𝓲𝓰𝓱𝓵𝓲𝓰𝓱𝓽𝓼 𝓼𝓸 𝓯𝓪𝓻[/h2]

The response from our incredible community during Next Fest has been nothing short of phenomenal. A heartfelt thank you to everyone who participated and competed in our competition! Our dedicated team has been hard at work addressing bugs and implementing small improvements based on your invaluable feedback. The remaining suggestions have been carefully noted and added to our post-Next Fest to-do list.

[h3]Quick Stats[/h3]
[list]
[*] Over 300 individual entries into our leaderboards
[*] 150,000+ points collected
[*] 5,000+ incinerated rides :(
[*] Over 300 people raced their hearts out across all 3 levels
[*] 1 super hot QOL fix
[/list]

[h2]LAST CHANCE TO [b]WIN $25[/b] IN STEAM VOUCHERS![/h2]

Feeling competitive? Now's your last chance to join the race for a chance to win $25 in Steam Vouchers! Here's how you can enter:

[olist]
[*] Set your best time on level 2.
[*] Take a screenshot of the finish line screen OR record your play-through of level 2.
[*] Follow us on social media or join the Discord.
[*] Tag us with your screenshot or video using the hashtags #SteamNextFest and #retrodrive.
[/olist]

The winner of the Next Fest race will be unveiled on the event's final day! Additional details can be found in-game – best of luck!

To report bugs or provide feedback, please post in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2142380]Steam forums[/url] or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/kxXP8svE]Discord server[/url].

[b]Wishing you all the best, happy gaming, and stay rad![/b] :summer2019city:

notes.title: End of year update 2023
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the release of a major update for Retro Drive Revamped, bringing exciting new features, improvements, and content to enhance your retro racing experience. Here's what's new:

[olist]
[*] [b]Tapes Placement Fix:[/b]
We've heard your feedback loud and clear - tapes should be a reward, not a punishment! With this update, tapes are now properly placed on the screen, ensuring a fair and enjoyable challenge for all retro racers.
[*] [b]Save System Enhancement:[/b]
We've thoroughly checked and improved the save system to ensure its viability for seamless future content additions. Your progress is now in safe hands, ready for new adventures on the horizon.
[*] [b]Audio Pitch Issue Resolved:[/b]
No more unexpected pitch changes! Going from level 9 to level 1 will no longer cause audio issues. Say goodbye to pitch shifts during game over incidents like hitting a camper van.
[*] [b]City Level Stuck Fix:[/b]
Getting stuck facing up in the city level is now a thing of the past. Glide through the cityscapes smoothly and without any unexpected roadblocks.
[*] [b]Crisp Pixel Art in Credits:[/b]
We've sharpened up the pixel art in the credits, ensuring a clearer and more visually pleasing acknowledgment of the talented individuals who contributed to Retro Drive Revamped.
[*] [b]AICar_Red (7) Correction:[/b]
The notorious red car at the start of level 8 has been tamed. Prepare for a fairer race without any unexpected challenges from this particular rival.
[*] [b]Map Menu Music Fix:[/b]
Levels now have the music they deserve! The map menu is no longer silent - enjoy the soundtrack as you navigate through the different levels.
[*] [b]Oil Slick Balance Adjusted:[/b]
Oil slicks are now more balanced, offering a challenging yet fair obstacle for players. Navigate the tracks with precision and skill without the frustration of unbalanced gameplay.
[*] [b]Japanese Font:[/b]
Our Japanese font has passed the test! Retro Drive Revamped is now even more accessible to our Japanese players, ensuring a smooth reading experience.
[*] [b]Multilingual Tips:[/b]
Tips are now localized, providing helpful advice to all players, regardless of language preference. Get ready to race with confidence, no matter where you're from.
[/olist] 

Thank you for your patience and valuable feedback. We're committed to delivering an optimal racing experience, and we can't wait to see you on the improved tracks!

[previewyoutube=AjKrTxg7GrQ;full][/previewyoutube]
